name: Devin (incl. Windsurf)
summary: Cognition's AI software engineer and Windsurf AI code editor.
description: Devin, from Cognition, is an autonomous AI software engineer that runs parallel cloud agents to plan, write and ship code. Cognition also owns the Windsurf AI code editor: windsurf.com now redirects to devin.ai/desktop, which manages local and cloud agents from the editor. The Free plan ($0) gives a light quota, Pro costs $20/month, Max $200/month and Teams $80/month plus $40 per developer seat.
